pending.title: Golden Hour Motion Blur Portrait
pending.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic photograph of the person in the photo, captured in strong, striking movement with intense motion blur. The subject is wearing their original outfit, standing outdoors in a lush green meadow at golden hour. Strong warm golden backlight creates a luminous halo around their hair and shoulders, with dense dark green trees in the background. Only the face remains a sharp focal anchor point, while the body, arms, and fabric are heavily blurred from the motion. Hair is caught dramatically in the wind, catching the backlight and glowing. Use a [POSE: mid-turn looking over shoulder] pose, and a [COLOR_PALETTE: warm golden amber and deep rich green] color grade. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged, and preserve their exact hairstyle, hair length, and body type.
